_comment: Acceptance thresholds for scripts/audit/*. Word floors mirror docs/content-standards.md section 1 and are measured inside <main> (site chrome excluded). doorwayMinUniqueTokens is the measurable half of the doorway test (section 2): the number of tokens a page must carry that its nearest sibling of the same type does not. Measured 2026-08-23: locations score 2 (3 for two-word city names) and services 13-23 -- the floor is the target, not the baseline.
